column1:
Examples of possible gender-
focused outcomes for  
energy sector
column2:
Examples of questions to consider 
to formulate project strategies and 
gender-related design features

• 	How	can	women	be	involved	as	
service providers? What support 
is required to promote women’s 
equitable involvement?
• 	Do	analyses	on	potential	
implications of adopted technologies 
take gender into account?
column3:
• 	Ensure	availability	of	a	greater	choice	
of efficient, nonpolluting cookstove 
technologies using renewable and 
traditional energy sources.
• 	Arrange	for	user	education	programs	to	
raise awareness about energy-efficient 
technologies and induce positive  
behavior patterns.
